reason: I already have my Toplux and I reorder it when it runs out, so I have no reason to switch. Honestly I forget my vitamins on the counter half the time anyway, so a new box would just sit there too.
objection: Sachets feel like more packaging waste, 30 foil packets a month for something I can already get in a bottle.
would_change_my_mind: If my current brand stopped working for me or got pulled, or if it came in a bottle or refill pouch instead of single foil sachets, I might try it.
